description: Declarative effect definitions normalized by the CBP rules runtime.

profile.purpose: small active-user marker and preferences only

rendering.final_operation: smoothscale native render target to centered aspect-preserving window viewport

watching.house_player: the participant recorded in accepted_by/house_player when the request is accepted
watching.scene: full DuelScene using the engine-backed live world session
watching.orientation: house_player is engine.player so the board, opponent rotation, hand, LP, and reactions use the house POV

duel_ai.scope: duel decisions only; world relationships, trading, and character-stat simulation are separate systems
duel_ai.autonomous_actor: pending interaction owner or chain priority side, otherwise active side
duel_ai.regression: completed deterministic AI-vs-AI duels must resolve without stalls and exercise summons, sets, activations, trap windows, flips, and shared combat

character_cognition.knowledge_rule: own cards and legally visible cards are known; hidden opponent hand, deck, and facedown identities remain uncertain until observed or learned with confidence
character_cognition.preference_matching: case-insensitive family, card-kind, subtype, card-ID, and place matching; absent preferred content does not block play
character_cognition.learning: bounded observation records carry confidence, recency, sightings, opponent association, and outcome context; repeated snapshots in one phase do not inflate sightings

relationships.transitions: interaction and authored world events append relationship_history and update directional ally/enemy sets

team_foundation.member_order: preserved; leader must be a member
team_foundation.individuality: team members remain separate character actors for duel decisions, knowledge, reactions, and media

deck_foundation.collections: main_cards are drawn; fusion_cards are face-down Fusion/Extra cards and are never drawn
deck_foundation.wording_reconciliation: The authoritative GDD range 40-80 is retained; a later up-to-40 phrase is treated as a 40-card target rather than an override.

legendary_card_contract.registry_rule: legendary_type is unique across Legendary cards; Legendary metadata is forbidden on other kinds
legendary_card_contract.removal_rule: non_removable Legendary cards reject movement to graveyard, banished, hand, or deck while on the field

trio_distribution.source: team distribution contract plus card distribution metadata
trio_distribution.selection: only cards marked eligible, pool-matching, unowned_at_start, and currently unowned
trio_distribution.recipient_rule: one grant per opportunity to the lowest-population eligible recipient; duplicate ownership is rejected
trio_distribution.persistence: distribution_sequence, simulation_events, card_discoveries, character libraries, and histories use modular runtime collections

narrator_idle.cadence: repeat after each threshold without a meaningful observation
narrator_idle.rendering: cue state is emitted to the data tree; background simulation does not render audio

performance_measurement.benchmark: external dummy-driver steady-state update, 1920x1080 draw, final window scale

packages.dependency_closure: character/team/deck exports include referenced decks, cards, optional places, logic, and nested media only
packages.experience: optional runtime character/team state selected explicitly
packages.import_rule: only manifest-listed categories and IDs are imported; world state is never merged unless the package explicitly includes world and the caller requests it; requested categories are selective and support replace, skip, and reject conflicts
packages.media: nested entity media is preserved under data/<category>/... with path traversal rejected

real_time_world.runtime_rule: advance_world() consumes non-negative computer-clock delta; explicit seconds are reserved for external controlled test harnesses
real_time_world.restart_rule: next runtime tick advances by elapsed time since the persisted last_wall_time; monotonic backward-clock jumps produce zero delta
real_time_world.checkpoint: modular world collections and world index; no authored world.json mutation

trading.expiry: three simulated real-time hours via expires_sim_time
trading.valuation: relationship-aware card value using stars, stats, preferences, knowledge, risk, and social relation
trading.transaction: ownership changes atomically after both sides have available cards; every card movement is journaled and discovered
trading.media: text-like negotiation state does not require vocal playback; optional scene media remains separate

borrowing.consent: borrower opens a request and lender explicitly accepts, denies, ignores, or the borrower cancels
borrowing.constraints: lender cards are reserved while requested or active; borrower deck copy limits are checked; active loans are injected into runtime deck preparation without changing authored deck ownership
borrowing.return: loan marker is removed after the agreed completed-duel count and lender ownership remains conserved
borrowing.team_scope: team-member borrowing and trade records carry team_id and team history

championships.host_rule: host rank, five decks of at least fifty cards, and level-scaled library minimum are checked before creation
championships.match_rule: current TEAMvTEAM TeamDuelEngine sessions are scheduled into available places on the real-time world timeline; timed and gamble modes are rejected
championships.progression: completed rounds populate the next bracket, distribute round-scaled rewards, update histories/ranks/achievements, and emit narrator intro/outro cues
championships.observation: watcher IDs are carried into active championship battle records without rendering background media

persona_runtime.rule: decisions use only owned or legally visible information; hidden cards and hidden deck contents are never read as knowledge
persona_runtime.evolution: social outcomes and observed results update durable behavior weights, memories, goals, and relationship direction

interaction_lifecycle.legacy_collections: each family remains in its own modular collection and is mirrored into the catalog
interaction_lifecycle.permissions: sender may cancel; recipient or open-order taker may accept, deny, or ignore; transitions append directional actor events
interaction_lifecycle.media: each transition may emit a relationship-aware media selection into simulation_events for future scene playback

media.animation_variants: animations/<event>/<1-10>/numbered image frames or numbered video files
media.audio_variants: audio/<event>/<1-10>.<format> or numbered files paired by variant
media.pairing: one selected variant binds its animation and audio; animation and audio are never independently randomized
media.duration: paired media runs for the longer stream and preserves the shorter stream according to mode

attack_presentation.anchors: normalized side, zone, slot index, and card ID; renderer maps anchors to the authored DuelLayout

card_reactions.hit_damage: target shake and red impact flash
card_reactions.flip: reveal flash and card-specific animation/audio in the card image area
card_reactions.destroy: break overlay and graveyard movement cue

media.fallback: missing optional animation, audio, video, or place track falls back through entity, relationship, place, universal, and placeholder sources without blocking gameplay
media.place_music: place/music/<day|night>/<state>/ with up to ten variants and universal duel fallback
media.lifecycle: scene-scoped optional assets are loaded on demand, bounded in cache, and released when the scene exits
media.video: supported video media is decoded as visual frames without requiring embedded sound

spin_dicer.animation: authored face images cycle every 0.09 simulated seconds with rotation and bounce presentation
spin_dicer.rng: deterministic from simulation time, monotonic dice sequence, launcher ID, and requester ID
spin_dicer.narrator: data/narrator/spin_dicer.json with up to ten text variants per state and optional paired audio under data/narrator/audio/<state>/
spin_dicer.world_autonomy: queued battles persist pre_duel requester/acceptor, accept-or-deny decision, narrator states, spin result provenance, and first_side

triggers.loser_to_winner: the actual loser supplies the configured cards
triggers.placer_loss: the configured giver supplies cards only when that giver is the actual loser

duel_rewards.unavailable: selection returns no cards without mutating ownership
duel_rewards.persistence: active battle reward policy and completed transfer event are stored in modular world collections

duel_orders.acceptance: accepting an order creates a linked duel_order request with exact place/deck/reward terms before marking the order fulfilled
duel_orders.failure: if linked request creation fails, the order remains open and no fulfillment is recorded
duel_orders.ai_selection: free non-player characters score valid open orders by relationship, place preference, reward value, and enemy bias

watchers.slots: three left and three right around the live duel table
watchers.media: character-scoped watching-in frames/audio resolve by relationship with optional right-side mirroring; missing media falls back to portrait/placeholder
watchers.persistence: watcher IDs are stored in battle records and cbp.state-checkpoint.v1 payloads and restored into reconstructed sessions
watchers.behavior: bounded relationship-weighted watcher pressure modifies visible-information AI card scoring only
watchers.audio: place-duel landscape watcher presentation is muted; full live house-POV DuelScene may play configured watcher audio

place_duel_view.duels: place-scoped live tables with current LP, phase, turn, step count, and WATCH LIVE house POV
place_duel_view.landscape: day/night place visual with watcher roster and live table summary
place_duel_view.player_media: no player vocals or character animation in landscape mode; watcher visuals may appear muted
place_duel_view.live_source: world active battle and reconstructed DuelEngine session, never a replay recording

narrator_tree.variant_contract: state entries support up to ten text variants; selected text/audio variant is deterministic and optional audio never blocks state progression
narrator_tree.fallback: global state variant remains valid when place-specific narrator media is absent

point13_world.request_rule: requests remain visible and answerable while a recipient is in a duel; acceptance queues until both participants are available
point13_world.out_of_game: out_of_game_until and world_status are persisted per character; pending requests remain in modular world collections and activate after return

journals.character: duel, request, discovery, availability, and learning entries keyed by character ID
journals.team: formation, consent, team-duel, place-effect, and championship entries keyed by team ID
journals.place: occupancy, duel, effect, landscape, and championship entries keyed by place ID

point13_world.card_discovery: knowledge is updated only from owned, public, observed, or learned provenance; hidden cards remain unknown

team_formats.rotation: each round selects the next roster member; each member remains an independent character actor
team_formats.outcome: final team winner is determined from round wins; concrete winning and losing members are attributed from resolved rounds
team_formats.reward: only a final concrete team outcome may transfer one reward; timed and gamble terms are restricted to 1v1
team_formats.journal: team_duel_completed is recorded for both teams and the place

timed.expiry: higher LP resolves as timed-instant-win or timed-instant-lose for the house; equal LP is a timed draw with no winner and no reward transfer

gamble.wager: house and guest reserve equal pools of one through ten owned cards
gamble.selection: winner selects exactly one card from the loser pool while all cards are face-down; selected card reveals first, then all remaining cards reveal and return
gamble.draw: all reserved cards return to original owners

team_place_effects.cost: three distinct cards owned by three linked team members
team_place_effects.selection: one candidate is selected permanently for the linked place
team_place_effects.journal: candidate creation and permanent selection are recorded for team and place

summon_procedure.material_selector: canonical selector predicate for eligible materials
summon_procedure.required_card_ids: ordered or repeated authored card IDs; exact Fusion matching compares instance-safe multisets
summon_procedure.min_stars: exact total material Level for Ritual procedures
summon_procedure.exact: Fusion recipe exactness; Ritual uses the separate exact Level rule
summon_procedure.source_zones: explicit source collection list; Fusion uses extra, Ritual uses hand, Legendary may use hand and graveyard
summon_procedure.source_selector: selector for the summon card source state
summon_procedure.source_method: provenance method recorded for the summoned card

enabler.effect_ids: optional exact authored enabler effect IDs

summon_procedure.required_count: exact material count for authored tribute procedures; normal tribute tiers are loaded from data/rules.json
summon_procedure.costs: ordered reusable cost objects applied before material selection

runtime_fields.current_duels: stored in data/runtime/world/index.json under place_occupancy; never written to authored data/places.json

event_name.enabled: boolean; false or absent keeps the event non-blocking
event_name.mandatory: boolean; card response required while a legal candidate exists
event_name.allow_pass: boolean; explicit PASS override, otherwise false for mandatory policies
event_name.priority: opposite or explicitly authored priority side
event_name.phases: optional normalized phase names allowed for the response window
event_name.source_kinds: optional source-card kinds allowed for the response window
event_name.target_zones: optional target-card zones required by the response window

event_name_or_*.enabled: boolean; wildcard applies to events without an exact entry
event_name_or_*.events: optional list of allowed event names or any
event_name_or_*.phase: single phase or list of normalized phases

event_record.source_card_id: card causing or carrying the event
event_record.source_zone: source card zone at event creation
event_record.metadata: event-specific movement, damage, summon, attack, or state fields
event_record.response_window: optional metadata flag; a window opens only when the opposing priority side has a legal response
event_record.trigger_group_id: stable ID shared by effects collected for this event
event_record.trigger_group_order: effect IDs in deterministic priority/card/effect order
event_record.trigger_group_selected_order: effect IDs selected by the chooser when a group is prompted
event_record.observation_sequence: monotonic live-observation record sequence; excludes wall-clock ordering
event_record.replacement_records: ordered mutation records showing replacement IDs, operations, before, after, and amounts

event_response_window.priority: opposite side of the event actor
event_response_window.context: preserves event trigger, actor, source, targets, and event metadata

trigger_group.members: ordered effect descriptors with priority and ordering_key
trigger_group.resolved: effect IDs dispatched in the recorded order
trigger_group.selected_order: optional player or AI-selected effect order
trigger_group.included_ids: effect IDs selected for dispatch; optional effects may be omitted
trigger_group.required_ids: effect IDs that must be included
trigger_group.optional_ids: effect IDs eligible for omission when optional_effects is prompt
trigger_group.excluded_ids: optional effect IDs omitted by a none or prompt policy

trigger_order_policy.enabled: boolean; enable an order prompt when more than one effect matches
trigger_order_policy.mandatory: boolean; the selected order must include every group member
trigger_order_policy.fallback: deterministic fallback label for non-prompt paths
trigger_order_policy.order_validation: prompt selections must contain every required ID, no duplicates, and only allowed optional IDs

condition_composition.all: nested predicates that must all match
condition_composition.any: nested predicates where at least one must match
condition_composition.not: single nested predicate that must not match

notify.text: Discard one card to activate this effect.

selector.card_id: exact authored card ID or array
selector.name: exact authored card name or array

visibility.public: face-up field and graveyard/banished records are visible
visibility.hidden: opponent hand/deck/facedown identity is projected as hidden

live_observation.snapshot: viewer-scoped public state, current event records, and learned card/effect IDs for live duel spectators
live_observation.checkpoint: cbp.observation-checkpoint.v1 with canonical SHA-256 digest for inspection-state integrity
live_observation.state_checkpoint: cbp.state-checkpoint.v1 serializable zone, duel-state, chain, and supported pending-prompt payload with digest validation
live_observation.purpose: current live-duel viewer projections and diagnostics only; no record-and-rewatch playback

knowledge.effect_facts: observed trigger, action, speed, and optionality facts
knowledge.outcome_facts: future-compatible result observations; current runtime records legality and status
knowledge.import: unknown card/effect IDs are filtered against the current content registry

summon.method: special, normal, fusion, ritual, or authored method key
summon.select: selector for cards to summon from deck, hand, graveyard, banished, or another legal zone

summon_procedure.kind: tribute, fusion, ritual, legendary, or authored procedure key
summon_procedure.material_selector: shared selector predicate for eligible materials
summon_procedure.required_card_ids: exact material IDs when exact is true
summon_procedure.min_stars: exact material-Level total for Ritual procedures
summon_procedure.locations: allowed source zones such as hand and monster
summon_procedure.exact: whether the selected IDs must equal required_card_ids
summon_procedure.material_destination: graveyard or banished; unsupported destinations are blocked explicitly
summon_procedure.source_selector: optional selector for the summon card source
summon_procedure.source_method: provenance method recorded on the summon
summon_procedure.required_count: exact material count for tribute procedures
summon_procedure.costs: ordered reusable cost objects applied before material selection

grant_normal_summon.count: number of additional normal summon permissions
grant_normal_summon.per_turn: whether the grant is replenished at the owner's next turn
grant_normal_summon.cost: optional cost object, including pay_hp amount

negate_chain.reference: previous, latest, oldest, link ID, or a link selector object; the active link cannot negate itself
negate_chain.selector: optional link selector containing link_id, effect_id, trigger, actor, or speed
negate_chain.status: only pending links are legal negation targets
negate_chain.history: records source link and source effect provenance in chain history

response_cost.discard: response activation may emit choose_cards and resume as a chain link after payment
response_cost.pay_hp: response activation may pay HP before adding its chain link
response_cost.cost_paid: chain context marker preventing a resolved response from paying twice

action.target: selector id, source, actor, or explicit target

target_policy.snapshot: captured legal target IDs at selection-window creation

action.duration: instant, until_end_of_turn, per_turn, while_face_up, while_source_on_field, while_source_face_up, permanent, or phase window
action.condition: optional predicate list; summon_method, summon_source_zone, summon_source_card_id, and summon_source_effect_id are supported provenance fields

modifier_runtime.continuous: boolean; register this modifier as a runtime effect when resolved
modifier_runtime.layer: integer layer ordering; lower layers apply first
modifier_runtime.duration: expiry contract evaluated at phase/turn boundaries or from source state
modifier_runtime.replacement: optional event-value replacement object with event, operation, amount, selector, priority, and once
modifier_runtime.legality_record: resolution result contains source_present, target_ids, target_count, and status

summon_provenance.summon_method: normal, special, fusion, ritual, or authored method key
summon_provenance.summon_source_zone: deck, hand, graveyard, banished, extra, or another zone key
summon_provenance.summon_source_card_id: exact effect-card ID that caused a special summon
summon_provenance.summon_source_card_name: exact effect-card name that caused a special summon
summon_provenance.summon_source_effect_id: exact effect definition ID that caused a special summon

control.controller: actor becomes the current controller and the move emits a control event

chain.priority: side currently allowed to add a response link
chain.passes: alternating priority passes before resolving the stack
chain.negated: link state set by a valid negation effect
chain.legality: source controller, spell speed, target IDs, count, and target snapshot captured at link admission

notification.default: answer used only when an automatic policy is explicitly allowed
notification.payload: structured data for the renderer and resolver; procedure_materials payloads include procedure, card, candidate_ids, required, min_stars, locations, exact, material_destination, selected_ids, and selected_stars; chain_response payloads include chain ID, priority, and legal response card IDs

data_contract.rule: Imported effect and deck records must already use the canonical schema; malformed records are rejected rather than normalized.
